title: School Partnerships
metaDescription: Partner your school with the Global Reasoning Challenge for dedicated tools, reduced fees, and recognition.
body:
Home / School Partnerships
For schools

School Partnerships

Strengthen your school's involvement in GRC with dedicated tools, reduced fees for larger groups, and formal recognition.

How schools participate

Schools are entered automatically as soon as one student registers under the school's name — there is no separate signup required to take part. Make sure every student enters the school name the same way, so participation is counted correctly.

Partnership benefits

A formal School Partnership adds dedicated coordination tools, reduced registration costs for the Semi-Final Round, and recognition for integrating GRC into your academic calendar.

School Awards

Schools with strong participation and performance receive International and National School Awards at the end of each edition. See Awards for the full structure.

Start a partnership
